# Mediabunny 1.65.0

Unmodified browser bundle by Vanilagy and contributors, licensed under MPL-2.0.

- Upstream: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny
- Corresponding source: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/cd6612380c7e3f1261d74b9b550e6fc3b65a53bc
- Official package containing source and build metadata: https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.65.0.tgz
- Documentation: https://mediabunny.dev/
- License: [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt)

The bundle supplied with Autoplay Studio 1.1.7 was compared byte for byte with
the official npm tarball. The tarball's SHA-512 integrity was verified against
the official npm registry before integration. See UPSTREAM.json for the exact
version, commit, integrity and bundle SHA-256. No runtime CDN or network download
is needed to load this library.

Mediabunny is loaded only when video rendering or streaming music decoding is
requested. Its license applies to the covered library; RPEN's separate license
and the notices for other contributions remain applicable.
